study type: Population-based retrospective cohort study; interrupted time series analyses
exposure: Removal of race and ethnicity from the vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) calculator
outcome: Rates of trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
Rates of vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC)
cohort: Women in the United States eligible for trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC), including specific racial and ethnic groups.
finding: The removal of race and ethnicity from the VBAC calculator was not associated with changes in rates of TOLAC or VBAC in the overall eligible population or among major racial and ethnic groups.
mod_finding: Rates of successful VBAC remained lower for Hispanic, non-Hispanic Asian, and non-Hispanic Black people compared with non-Hispanic White people, highlighting persistent racial disparities.
